payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed models utilize dialog turn sizes of 3 and 5, suggesting that dialog history is captured over multiple turns, specifically up to 5 turns based on the performance metrics discussed.

claims.text: The proposed models capture dialog history effectively with a turn size of up to 5.
The models analyze dialog context by connecting the last RNN state of turn k-2 to turn k, indicating a history of at least 2 turns.
The maximum turn length in the dataset is set to 160, which implies that dialog history can be extensive.
